data.heading: 1. Kharif Season Sowing Status:
data.text: -  Kharif  sowing  data  collection  has  started from  05 th June,  2026  and  the  sowing  is  in  preliminary stage. As on 19 June 2026, the area sown under Kharif crops is 119.90 lakh ha (including 57.31 lakh ha in Sugarcane) as compared to 117.95 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.

data.heading: Week 1 (19 June - 25 June 2026):
data.text:
-  Gradual fall in maximum temperatures by about 2°C likely over Northwest India till 22nd June 2026, gradual rise by 2- 3°C for subsequent 3 days and no significant change thereafter.
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over Maharashtra till 21th June and gradual fall by 2-3°C thereafter.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text: -  Heat wave conditions very likely in isolated pockets over Chhattisgarh on 22nd & 23rd June; East Madhya  Pradesh,  Vidarbha  during  22nd-25th  June,  East  Uttar  Pradesh  during  22nd-24th  June; Telangana on 22nd June; with severe heat wave conditions in isolated pockets during 22nd-24th June.

data.heading: Week 2 (26 June - 02 July 2026):
data.text:
-  Low  probability  of  Heatwave  conditions  likely  over  parts  of  northwest  India  (Rajasthan,  Punjab, Haryana & Uttar Pradesh), and central India (Vidarbha and adjoining regions of North Telangana) on some days of week.
-  Above normal (+1.6 to +3.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over many parts of the plains of northwest India, central India, north peninsular India, and East India. Near-normal weekly maximum temperatures (-1.5 to +1.5°C) are likely across the rest of the country during the week.

data.heading: Kharif Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Sugarcane :  About 57.31 lakh ha area coverage (106% of Normal area) has been reported compared to 56.64 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Cotton :  About  17.13  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  22.82  lakh  ha  during  the corresponding period of last year.
-  Jute :  About  6.22  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  6.09  lakh  ha  during  the corresponding period of last year.
